subject: Superintendent Roy Belson Early Retirement
overview: Superintendent Roy Belson announced his early retirement following community backlash over an unreported loaded gun magazine found at a middle school. Officials also approved new school safety protocols, including ALICE training and mandatory immediate reporting to police.

items.title: Early retirement announcement and apology
items.summary: Superintendent Roy Belson announced he will retire two months early on April 30 after facing criticism for waiting two months to report a loaded gun magazine found in a middle school auditorium.

items.title: Student demands for safety transparency
items.summary: Students called on leadership to be proactive, transparent, and responsive to student concerns regarding safety.

items.title: Implementation of new school safety protocols
items.summary: Officials announced safety measures including ALICE training, a school safety advisory committee, and an immediate policy requiring anyone finding potential safety hazards on school grounds to notify police right away.
